chunks.text: To rotate an API key, create a replacement key with the same scopes and deploy it to every service that uses the old key.
Revoke the old key only after the replacement has been deployed everywhere; revocation takes effect within a minute.
A lost key cannot be recovered. Create a replacement key and revoke the lost one as soon as possible.

answer: Create a replacement key with the same scopes and deploy it to each service [c1]. Revoke the old key only once the replacement is deployed everywhere [c3]. Then restart the gateway so the new key is picked up [c1]. Revocation takes effect within a minute [c2].
